Dear Ms de Wit,

Marloes from your webshop team told me at the Tuinbeurs last month that you were looking for someone to take over the newsletter and Google Ads, so here is my letter.

I have done more or less exactly that for Groen & Co for the last three years. The budget there is small, so I have learnt to be careful with it, and I would honestly like to work somewhere with a bit more room to try things. Your spring catalogue was the first one in years that I kept.

I am not a designer and I will not pretend to be one, but I can shoot a decent product photo and I know my way around Klaviyo. I can start in January, as my notice period is one month.

I'd be happy to come by and show you some of the campaigns.

Kind regards,

Pieter Bakker
